symptom: Agent-editor documents produced no refs and a microflow passed as a microflow-typed Java action parameter was no reference: an agent's tool microflow, a chat context's ActionMicroflow and MCPServer.AddPrompt's Microflow showed '(no callers found)' and sat in GRAPH_DEAD_ASSETS, though deleting one breaks the app at runtime and neither mx check nor a build notices.
cause: The agent pass read only the CustomBlobDocument wrapper (name, documentation), not the JSON Contents with tools, model, knowledge bases and key; and microflowActionRef emitted only the Java action itself, skipping MicroflowParameterValue and CustomBlobDocumentCodeActionParameterValue in the parameter mappings.
insight: The decoders already existed for describe agent in modelsdk/mprread; exporting one entry point beat re-parsing the JSON in the catalog. Resolve tool targets in buildReferences, not in the agent pass: the agent phase runs before microflows are catalogued. Measure with GRAPH_DEAD_ASSETS, main vs fix, on the Agent Builder starter app: 238 -> 208, 30 assets no longer dead and none newly dead; spot-check that each is real (MCPServer.AddPrompt(Microflow = ...) in MCPServer_Initialize). Build the 'main' binary with make build, not go build: go build fails on the generated embed dirs, and an empty baseline made every dead asset look new. Not covered: a nanoflow passed to a JavaScript action (Nanoflows$NanoflowParameterValue), which the SDK does not decode.
